My team options:
- Garchomp (Dragon/Ground): Life Orb, Sandveil - 183/183 HP, 182 ATK, 107 SPE
- Toxapex (Poison/Water): Leftovers, Regenerator - 157/157 HP, 224 DEF, 55 SPE
- Hydreigon (Dark/Dragon): Choice Scarf, Levitate - 167/167 HP, 177 SpA, 165 SPE

The opponent is a scripted control bot with the exact same team. This is a mirror battle essentially.

Key considerations:
1. Garchomp leads well - it's fast (107 base), has Life Orb for power, and can set up Stealth Rock. It hits hard with Earthquake and Dragon Claw.
2. Toxapex is a great wall - Regenerator gives free healing, high DEF, Toxic + Haze are useful.
3. Hydreigon with Choice Scarf is the fastest special attacker on the team (165 base). Dracometeor is devastating but has low PP (8). Nasty Plot can set up.

For a mirror battle against a control bot:
- Garchomp as lead makes sense - it's fast, powerful, and can pressure. Life Orb + Earthquake/Dragon Claw gives good coverage.
- Toxapex as the second slot is great for walling and setting up Toxic/Haze.
- Hydreigon with Choice Scarf as the third slot gives a fast special sweeper threat.

This trio covers: physical attacker (Garchomp), defensive wall (Toxapex), special sweeper (Hydreigon). Good balance.

The opponent is a "control bot" - likely plays defensively, sets up hazards, uses status moves. Garchomp can break through with its power, Toxapex can clean up and set Toxic/Haze, Hydreigon can sweep if it gets the lead or comes in on a switch.

I'll go with: BRING: garchomp, toxapex, hydreigon
